## Update

Change the version in `package.json`, `package-lock.json` (`sfw npm install`) and
`bin/sync/packages.php`, then run `composer vendor:sync` and `composer notices`.
A new major version of the package, or removed icon names, needs a major version of the theme.

## Provenance and checksums

- `UPSTREAM`: package, version, `resolved` and `integrity` from `package-lock.json`,
  copied paths and post-processing (removed `sourceMappingURL` comments; no `.map` files).
- `CHECKSUMS.txt`: sha256 of every file except itself and this README, sorted bytewise.
  `composer vendor:check` rebuilds the folder and compares it byte for byte.

This folder is generated by `bin/sync-vendor.php`. Do not edit it by hand.
